subject: Shiny Server Pro - new R process for every user?

messages.author: 6bbd1026ab8e57c7
messages.subject: Shiny Server Pro - new R process for every user?
parts:
I am using Shiny Server Pro and I have a question about the utilization_scheduler directive.

The documentation states "maxRequestsPerProc -- The number of concurrent connections that a single R process can support before it will begin to return 503 errors for new sessions." I am going to deliver a training course to ~10 users in the coming weeks where everyone will be logged into the application simultaneously and will likely make simultaneous requests to the server. I would like to configure the server such that every user gets their own R process. Is there any downside to this? What's unclear to me is if I set maxRequestsPerProc to 1, is it possible that 503 errors will be returned before the new R process is initiated for the next user?

Under this scenario I would set "utilization_scheduler 1 0.5 20;" or something similar.
